bullets.text: In Tiruttani, an elderly woman died and ten women were injured due to electric shock from a municipality-provided freezer box at a condolence event, so the office should ensure safety checks on municipal equipment.
In Tiruvallur, an elderly man died in a severe accident after a government bus wheel ran over him, prompting the office to monitor road safety measures.
Due to cyclone forecasts, holidays were announced for schools in Chennai and Thiruvallur, which the district team must monitor for weather disruptions.
The Madras High Court deferred to the Supreme Court regarding the Pallikaranai marshland construction freeze, leaving the restriction untouched while residents seek protection for families.
Chennai Metro Rail Limited issued notice to correct two contractors for poor progress on Phase-II OMR works, and the constituency team should track project acceleration.
Chennai grid delays put summer power supply at risk as transmission upgrades miss deadlines, which the office should watch closely ahead of high-demand months.
Over 800 ducks died from a mysterious illness near Uthukottai in Thiruvallur, leading veterinary officials to test samples and advise farmers on farm hygiene.
Investors lodged major complaints against an accused owner running a chit fund scam in Thiruvallur, and the district team must monitor the fraud investigation.
Commuters from Pattabiram and Avadi face difficulties reaching the city due to revised suburban train timetables, requiring the office to watch rail connectivity impacts.
Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science launched Tamil Nadu's first university-based center for future skills with 15 centers of excellence spanning AI and cloud computing.
Tamil Nadu launched the Namma Arasu WhatsApp chatbot to improve digital service delivery, which the portfolio team should monitor for public adoption.
Experts at a recent conclave explored the future of mediation and artificial intelligence to strengthen institutional trust and legal frameworks.
DMK leadership criticized TVK's proposed health policy regarding medical procurement versus liquor corporations, which the political team should monitor.
BJP Tamil Nadu released an AI-generated video mocking CM Vijay and the TVK government, drawing significant political attention across social media platforms.
